highlights.reason_zh: 通用开放与降价让高难度任务可测；独立榜单领先，但 max effort 成本与等待很高。
highlights.reason_en: General access and lower pricing make hard tasks testable; an independent leaderboard leads, but max-effort cost and latency are high.

highlights.reason_zh: Muse Ember 的低 API 价格会改变高频 agent 路由，但没有开放权重，质量仍需实测。
highlights.reason_en: Muse Ember pricing changes high-volume agent routing economics, but there are no open weights and quality needs testing.

highlights.reason_zh: Carbon 从受限预览转为付费 API，首发价改变模型成本比较。
highlights.reason_en: Carbon moved from restricted preview to a paid API, changing model-cost comparisons.

highlights.reason_zh: TPU 8tx 与 8i Max 把机密推理和大上下文做成专用系统；地区、配额与价格未完整披露。
highlights.reason_en: TPU 8tx and 8i Max specialize confidential inference and large context, while regions, quotas and prices remain incomplete.

highlights.reason_zh: 统一 harness 与公开样例让多模态知识工作可复跑，但完整题集仍私有。
highlights.reason_en: A common harness and public samples make multimodal knowledge work reproducible, but the full set remains private.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部成功并读完，并补搜模型、工具、研究、开源、基础设施、政策、小团队与多语言材料。Fable 文章只有日期精度，但窗口内 Claude Code release 确认可用；性能与规模数字普遍缺独立复现。 召回自检补录了 Meta、Google 与个人账户隐私材料；较早的社区模型因尚未完成独立核验而延后。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors succeeded and were read, with additional searches across models, tools, research, open source, infrastructure, policy, small teams and multilingual sources. The Fable article has date-only precision, but an in-window Claude Code release confirms availability; performance and scale claims generally lack independent reproduction. Recall review backfilled Meta, Google and consumer-account privacy material; older community models were deferred pending independent verification.
